## TRA Timeline

#### Business Combination and TRA execution

- 2015-03-17: HF2 Financial Management acquires a majority interest in ZAIS Group Parent, LLC; TRA executed between ZAIS Group Holdings, Inc. (PubCo) and the Non-Holdings Members (Christian M. Zugel, Sonia Zugel, Laureen Lim, the Zugel Family Trust, the Family Trust U/A Christian M. Zugel 2005 GRAT); 85% of Section 754 basis step-ups from future ZGP Unit exchanges plus a 100% pay-over to Founder Members on tax savings from Additional Founder Unit releases in the five-year post-close period.
- 2015-07-21: First Amendment: administrative cleanup of defined-term usage (Subsidiary/Subsidiaries); no economic terms changed.

#### Going-private and deregistration

- 2018-05-18: Going-private merger with Z Acquisition LLC (Zugel-controlled); $4.10/share to public stockholders; no TRA termination provisions in the merger agreement, no settlement payment.
- 2018-05-29: Form 15-12B deregistration; firm exits the EDGAR universe.

## Explanation

The ZAIS Group Holdings TRA was executed on March 17, 2015 at the closing of the Business Combination in which the SPAC HF2 Financial Management acquired a majority interest in ZAIS Group Parent, LLC, creating an Up-C structure. The PubCo would pay 85% of cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of ZGP Units by the Zugel-affiliated Non-Holdings Members (plus 100% of tax savings attributable to Founder Unit releases during the first five years). No exchanges ever occurred, so the TRA never accrued a liability. A July 2015 First Amendment made only administrative defined-term cleanup. On May 18, 2018 the firm was taken private by Z Acquisition LLC (also Zugel-controlled) at $4.10/share; the merger agreement contained no TRA termination provisions and triggered no Section 4.01 acceleration because no Unit exchanges had occurred. The firm deregistered eleven days later, and the TRA's post-merger status is not visible in the on-EDGAR record under this CIK; because the contract was effectively between Zugel-controlled parties on both sides after the merger, the status is recorded as Unknown rather than Terminated. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
